purpose: This table holds hourly historical weather observations for three New York area airports (EWR, JFK, LGA) spanning January through June 2013, with each row also carrying static reference attributes of the observing airport (name, municipality, elevation, and longest runway length).
usage: Read one row per airport per observed UTC hour; filter or join on airport_code together with observed_hour_utc (or the local date and hour pair) to retrieve the weather readings and airport metadata recorded at that hour.
limitations: The profile cannot fully confirm the grain: airport_code x observed_hour_utc yields 13,023 possible combinations against 13,014 actual rows, a small gap suggesting missing airport-hours rather than duplicates, which the deterministic grain check must confirm. Several weather columns carry real missing readings rather than data errors: wind_gust_mph is null 74.6% of the time, pressure_mb 11.5%, wind_dir_degrees 1.7%, and wind_speed_mph 0.02%. wind_speed_mph's maximum of 1048.36 mph is physically implausible for surface wind, but the profile gives no basis to encode this as a rule. captured_at is not flagged as airbyte metadata yet behaves like a pipeline capture timestamp and is retained per policy; a reviewer should re-check this. The airport reference columns (name, municipality, elevation, longest runway) are inferred to be static per-airport facts from their distinct_count matching airport_code's cardinality, not from any operator context, since none was supplied.
